ns2:section.sectionText: *Students must register for both the lecture and one discussion section. Due to preparation in their CS course sequence, students currently in the CS+ADV major ONLY may use completion of MATH 220/221 in place of statistics as the pre-requisite for this course. ADV and Ag Com majors must complete a statistics course and cannot substitute calculus as a pre-requisite to take ADV 281. Due to major demand, it will be determined by Jan. 14 if seats will open to campus.
